summary: Iteration 3 backend testing complete. Validated Finnhub real-price integration, /api/pitch-deck PDF endpoint, and regression sample for existing endpoints. All 11 new tests pass (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 874 lines — consider splitting PDF generation, AI handlers, and socket logic into modules for maintainability.

finnhub_fetch_loop mutates CANDIES[i]['base_price'] in place (line 245). This is a module-level constant being mutated by a background task; works but is mildly surprising. Documented behavior, no fix needed but worth noting.
/api/pitch-deck recomputes the AI narrative on every call (potentially slow). Consider caching for the demo or short-circuiting after one successful generation per session.
biggest_buy = max(buy_history, key=lambda h: 1, ...) at line 705 is a no-op (constant key); variable is also unused. Dead code, safe to remove.
Two on_event('startup'/'shutdown') handlers use deprecated FastAPI API — modern lifespan context is preferred but not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Used existing demo_session state. Tests perform additive fund/buy/wish operations only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend restart forces fresh Finnhub fetch (~7s warmup). After fetch, state.prices.AAPL > $200 (live), state.last_real_fetch is ISO timestamp. /api/pitch-deck returns ~19KB PDF with embedded matplotlib chart, 4 stat cards, AI narrative, and recent activity. AI narrative call may take 5-10s but has working fallback. Regression of prior 42 tests was sampled (state/fund/buy/approve/wish/limits) and all pass.
